newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Leighton wins A$33.5 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Leighton wins A$33.5 mln contract.

text.p: Construction contractor Leighton Holdings Ltd's Thiess Contractors unit had won the last major roadworks contract for the Sydney Olympics 2000 site, the New South Wales (NSW) state government said on Thursday.
NSW minister for the Olympics Michael Knight said in a statement the A$33.5 million contract includes the remaining roadworks, services and associated landscape works.
Knight said preliminary design of the roads had begun and work is expected to start in April 1997.
At 2.15 p.m. (0315 GMT), Leighton shares were six cents higher at A$5.06.
